LanguageData.PPC.description: The RA-P3 Pulsed Power Capacitor (PPC) stores large amounts of energy in a bank of ultra capacitors, which can be discharged in a single pulse by compatible Rimatomics energy weapons.
LanguageData.PPCWeaponsConsole.description: The RA-C85 Semi Automated Command Station (SACS) is required by all Rimatomics energy weapons, may require manning for certain weapons to function fully.
LanguageData.RadarDish.description: The RA-92 Target Acquisition and Communication System (TACS) uses a combination of technologies to track land and air based targets and communicate with weapon systems.
LanguageData.PPCTeslaCoil.label: Tesla coil
LanguageData.Tesla_Coil_Arc_Discharger.label: Tesla coil arc discharger
LanguageData.Tesla_Coil_Arc_Discharger.description: The Tesla Coil Arc Discharger discharges an arc of electricity that stuns enemies.
LanguageData.PPCADS.description:
The RA-22 Active Denial System (ADS) is a non-lethal, directed-energy weapon designated for area denial and crowd control.

It heats the skin of targeted human subjects causing them to break rank and flee.

Does not require line of sight.
Requires a manned SACS.
LanguageData.PPCTeslaCoil.description:
The RA-42T Tesla Coil delivers a huge electrical arc discharge to its targets, resulting in severe burns or death.

The Tesla Coil has automatic targeting and firing, is 100% accurate, fires at medium range, and sets targets on fire.

Manned SACS required for manual targeting.
LanguageData.PPCHEL.description: The RA-702 High Energy Laser (HEL) destroys enemy airborne projectiles such as mortar shells.\n\nWhen a mortar is fired, the system will check if the shell's trajectory will pass through the range of the HEL. If it will, the HEL will attempt to track the target, and fire once it is in range.
LanguageData.PPCRailgun.description:
The RA-1802D Punisher is a 25 round magazine fed railgun platform.

It uses large electromagnetic pulses to launch sabot projectiles to extreme velocities and ranges.

Requires line of sight.
Fire mission does not require line of sight.
Manned SACS required for manual targeting.
Requires a manned SACS.
LanguageData.PPCObelisk.description:
The RA-2152-X Obelisk is a directed energy weapon that uses a focused solid state laser to vaporize targets. The Obelisk is 100% accurate with long range, and wields devastating power.

The Obelisk has automatic targeting and firing.
Manned SACS required for manual targeting.
LanguageData.PPCMarauder.description: The RA-3b Marauder is a multi-barrel coaxial plasma reailgun platform. Large electromagnetic pulses fire a burst of accelerated plasma toroids to extreme velocities, causing explosive radiation emitting impacts.\n\nRequires a manned SACS.
LanguageData.RimatomicsShieldGenerator.description:
The RA-S4 Sentinel is an energy shield that uses a combination of lasers, microwaves, and arc discharges, to create plasma fields. The plasma fields can intercept physical or energy based projectile weapons.

A sensor detects a shockwave-producing event, which determines the direction and distance of the shockwave relative to a defended target to calculate a firing plan.

The device then attentuates the shockwave event using reflection, refraction, dispersion, absorption, and momentum transfer.
